name: Kinka
oneLiner: XNK is Kinka's gold-backed commodity token, with each token representing one troy ounce of 99.99% Japanese-brand gold bullion held with Loomis vaulting.
collateral: Each XNK represents one fine troy ounce equivalent of 99.99% Japanese-brand physical gold bullion held through Gold Management LLC and stored with Loomis International vaulting; issuer is Kinka (BVI) Ltd.
pegMechanism: XNK can be exchanged for physical gold through GM LLC/storage-company desks after AML/KYC; issuer docs describe a 321.5 XNK minimum for ten 1 kg bars, and secondary-market price tracks one fine troy ounce of gold.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Kinka terms reserve issuer discretion over transfers and exchange and allow restrictions on Ethereum addresses; the centralized issuer and physical-gold redemption process create a direct blacklistability surface.

mintAuthority.summary: XNK uses an owner-controlled legacy mintable ERC-20; minting is not finished and the owner is a contract whose signer/threshold setup was not verified.

controls.label: XNK legacy mintable token
controls.evidence: Ethereum reads returned owner() = 0x2691FBB371456eaC5C5AA0082a0f53C91249c044 and mintingFinished() = false at block 25166611. Source review showed onlyOwner mint and finishMinting.

controls.label: XNK owner contract
controls.evidence: code read returned contract bytecode; no Safe threshold or owner model was verified.

review.evidence: XNK source/RPC reads show ongoing owner mint ability. Phase 0c follow-up: 0x2691FBB371456eaC5C5AA0082a0f53C91249c044 is a contract (22kb), not a Safe (Safe API 422, getOwners() reverts). owner() on 0x2691 returned 0x50ea796bcf3d178a100b1f0ef44faaef64741bfe (another contract, 22kb). 0x50ea is not a Safe (getOwners reverts, required() reverts). Neither contract exposes a legible multisig interface. The control chain from XNK token → 0x2691 → 0x50ea is unresolvable without verified source or ABI.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the admin/signature model for owner contract 0x2691FBB371456eaC5C5AA0082a0f53C91249c044 and its owner 0x50ea796bcf3d178a100b1f0ef44faaef64741bfe. Neither is a Safe or known multisig. Source code not verified on Sourcify or Etherscan. Cannot determine signer count or threshold.

reserves.name: Physical gold bullion (99.99% Japanese LBMA Good Delivery brands, Loomis/GM custody)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Kinka (BVI) Ltd.; Gold Management LLC and Loomis International

reserveReview.rationale: Kinka documents XNK as representing 99.99% physical gold and describes redemption of 1 kg LBMA-hallmarked bars through Loomis International and affiliated warehouses after the published minimum holding threshold. The reserve is retained as one physical-gold slice; the medium risk classification reflects gold-market, issuer, custody, and physical-redemption exposure.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Kinka physical-gold backing and redemption disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reviewed sources identify the physical-gold reserve and Loomis/Gold Management route but do not disclose bar-level inventory, account segregation, or current provider shares.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Kinka identifies Gold Management and Loomis vaulting, but the reviewed documents do not establish statutory segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation safeguards, or current custody shares.

params.label: Physical gold bullion (99.99% Japanese LBMA Good Delivery brands)

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: XNK is reviewed as an issuer-native multichain token: supply is issued or redeemed by the issuer/operator on supported chains rather than through a separately identified third-party bridge token. Missing evidence for a public bridge lockbox keeps confidence below verified.
